sentences.text: The genus is defined by the type species Perijasaurus lapaz.
The holotype, a broken dorsal vertebra measuring 55 cm tall and 45 cm long, was found on March 27, 1943.
Workers of the Tropical Oil Company discovered the fossil on the western flank of the Serranía del Perijá mountain range.
Rincón et al. (2022) classified Perijasaurus as a basal member of the unranked family Eusauropoda.
This study determined the animal is closely related to Cetiosaurus, Patagosaurus, Bagualia, Nebulasaurus, and Spinophorosaurus.
This animal lived around 175 million years ago in the La Quinta Formation of northern Colombia and Venezuela.
Scientists interpret the environment as a tropical lowland forest.
Its location and time suggest that the first eusauropods achieved a wide spread before the breakup of Pangaea and the Toarcian faunal turnover.
